reason: Twenty-two thousand is two months of what my family earns, and even ₹1,999 a month is a big piece of our money while we save for the wedding and school fees. My wife washes by hand and it costs us nothing, so I cannot spend this on a machine now.
objection: I don't know this brand from TV. If the battery dies after three years, who in my village will fix it and how much will a new battery cost? Nobody has told me that price.
would_change_my_mind: If a big brand I know sold it for under ₹12,000, with a mechanic near my village and a fixed, low price for a new battery written down.
